title: Greenfield architecture
decision: Design Telchi greenfield; legacy is evidence, not inherited architecture.

title: Parquet + DuckLake + DuckDB + PostgreSQL 18
decision: Use Parquet storage, DuckLake lakehouse management, DuckDB execution, and PostgreSQL 18 catalog metadata.

title: PostgreSQL is catalog not warehouse
decision: PostgreSQL stores DuckLake metadata and does not store analytical facts.

title: Raw immutable / derived rebuildable
decision: Keep raw immutable and make derived products rebuildable from versioned inputs.

title: Same logical names DEV and PROD
decision: Use identical logical database and role names in DEV and PROD; isolate through infrastructure.

title: Security before retrieval
decision: Resolve identity permissions and allowed scope before entity resolution and data query.

title: Atomic truth separated from business semantics
decision: Preserve canonical reconstructible facts separately from versioned business interpretations.

title: Prepared business/current read models for CEO workloads
decision: Route normal executive questions to prepared business/current read models.

title: Legacy is semantic/performance baseline only
decision: Use legacy for semantics cases and performance baseline only.

title: Metric semantic versioning
decision: Identify every metric by metric_id plus semantic_version and never alter definitions silently.

title: DuckLake technical snapshot != business historical state
decision: Keep technical lakehouse versions distinct from business as-of reconstruction.

title: LLM does not calculate business numbers
decision: Use SQL and DuckDB for calculation; use the LLM for intent context and explanation.

title: Canonical IDs and evidence-based aliases
decision: Resolve canonical IDs first and permit only evidence-backed aliases.

title: Warehouse and branch are distinct entities
decision: Model warehouse and branch separately with versionable mappings and explicit unknown states.

title: L-products are priority universe for Telchi operational analysis
decision: Prioritize ItemCode LIKE 'L%' where applicable and require explicit control to mix non-L products.

title: Semantic gaps remain explicit not guessed
decision: Keep unresolved business semantics explicit until evidence supports a versioned definition.

title: PostgreSQL/DuckLake runtime uses dedicated non-superuser role
decision: Use team360_telchi_ducklake as a dedicated least-privilege runtime role.

title: Raw legacy is never DuckLake-owned
decision: Keep raw legacy outside DuckLake file ownership and lifecycle operations.

title: Performance is an architectural contract
decision: Apply warm data-query P95 targets and design fast paths to meet them.

title: Atomic is driven by business truth not SAP table mirroring
decision: Design atomic entities around business grain while preserving SAP native identities and lineage.

title: Separate Brand, Business Unit, Operating Model, Channel and Production Site
decision: Model brand business unit operating model sales channel and production site as distinct concepts.

title: Production Site Is Distinct From Warehouse
decision: Model production sites separately and permit each site to relate to multiple warehouses.

title: Product Operating Classification Must Be Evidence-Based
decision: Do not infer operating attributes brand or production site solely from ItemCode or naming.

title: Business Unit Taxonomy
decision: Accept business_unit as a canonical concept while its concrete taxonomy awaits business evidence.

title: Stable Canonical Schema, Extensible Reference Data
decision: Prefer catalog content and versioned relationships over column proliferation; change schema only for genuinely new concepts.

title: Telchi Product Manufacturing and Brand Ownership Are Distinct
decision: Treat is_telchi_product manufactured_by_telchi and brand_owned_by_telchi as independent derived predicates.

title: Contract Manufacturing and White-Label Belong to Industrial Production
decision: Represent third-party production and white-label with industrial facts arrangements parties and brand ownership.

title: Magistral Compounding Belongs to Pharmacy Botica Not Industrial Production
decision: Represent magistral preparation as a separate pharmacy fact and never as an industrial production order.

title: Portfolio Family and Product Business Type Are Independent Dimensions
decision: Separate portfolio_family from product_business_type business_unit and brand.
